title: Printable ratio practice sheet (lesson 59)
subject: Mathematics
unit: Summer 1: Enlargement and similarity; ratio and proportion; rates
source: Seeded from mathematics/y9 lesson 59 (Printable ratio practice sheet (portal worksheet for this lesson))
intro: Lesson 59: Ratio: simplifying and equivalent ratios. To understand how to simplify ratios, including ratios with decimals, fractions and different units, and write them as 1 : n

questions.model: Multiply both by 2 to remove the decimal: 7 : 4. 7 and 4 have no common factor.

questions.q: Simplify (a) 56 : 84 (b) 2.4 : 3.6 (c) ¼ : ⅚ (d) 750 ml : 2 litres; (e) write 8 : 30 in the form 1 : n
questions.model: (a) HCF 28: 56 ÷ 28 = 2, 84 ÷ 28 = 3. (c) Common denominator 12: 3/12 : 10/12; multiply both by 12: 3 : 10.

questions.q: A map scale is 4 cm : 1 km. Write it in the form 1 : n.
Red and blue tiles are in the ratio 3 : 5. When 12 more red tiles are added the ratio becomes 1 : 1. How many blue tiles are there?
questions.a: 3x + 12 = 5x, so x = 6 and there are 30 blue tiles

questions.q: Big question: how can decimals, fractions and units hide a simple ratio?
questions.a: Convert to the same units and to whole numbers first; then divide by the HCF to see the simple ratio.
